headline: The housing crisis in Spain: key points to understand why accessing a home is increasingly difficult
summary: A shortage of affordable flats, rising rents and difficulties rehabilitating buildings are fuelling a housing problem in Spain. The issue has moved from the property market to the streets, the report said.
why: Housing affordability shapes household spending, mortgage demand and political pressure on property and rental policy. Spain is one of Europe's large housing markets.
